items.item_text: This TEMPORARY position through our Temporary Office of the President Staffing program.

55% Establishes and maintains suppliers sites. Review all supplier documentation to ensure we have all the required and necessary backup to establish a supplier profile. Vetting of information and management of secure folder for Docusigned forms. Create/change the supplier in Oracle, ensuring that the correct tax reporting settings are used.
20% Regularly review supplier procedures for process improvements and policy/regulatory compliance.
10% Provides analytical support for the accounts payable team regarding tax compliance. review and establish foreign supplier profiles, ensuring that the correct tax reporting settings are used.
